title: Paytm board to consider first-ever bonus issue along with Q1FY27 results on this date. Check details
summary: One 97 Communications, Paytm's parent company, will consider a bonus share issue at its upcoming board meeting on July 20, 2026. This follows the company's financial results for Q1FY27, marked by rising stock prices and improved investor sentiment.
